title: DWC_usb31 IP config parameters -- port count / speed / endpoint limits (coreConsultant Chapter 4)
summary: DWC_usb31 (DesignWare USB 3.1 Controller) v2.10a Jan 2024 Databook Chapter 4 'Parameter Descriptions' (DWC_usb31_databook.txt lines 4795-7339+) is the authoritative IP-generation-time parameterization surface, organized into 8 tables: ROUTERIF-CIO, CIO, Basic, PHY, Device, Host, Advanced, and Register Power-On Value params. Every entry has Label/Description/Values/Default/Enabled:/Parameter Name (prefixed DWC_USB31_). Top-level mode fork: DWC_USB31_MODE = Device(0)/Host(1)/DRD(2)/Reserved-Hub(3) (line 4910), default derived from which license feature-authorize flag is true. PORT COUNT: DWC_USB31_HOST_NUM_U2_ROOT_PORTS (USB2 HS/FS/LS root ports) range 1-15 default 1, ~12K gates/port (line 6369); DWC_USB31_HOST_NUM_U3_ROOT_PORTS (USB3.1 ESS root ports) range 1-4 default 1, ~52K gates/port (line 6376), enabled only when MODE==1 (Host) && EN_USB2_ONLY==0 && EN_ROUTERIF==0 -- i.e. multi-port is Host-only, NOT available in DRD (matches Unsupported Configs 'Multi-Port DRD' and product catalog having only DRD-Single-Port, no DRD-Multi-Port SKU); DWC_USB31_NUM_HS_USB_INSTANCES (1-4, ~55K gates each) cannot exceed HOST_NUM_U2_ROOT_PORTS (explicit cross-param constraint, line 6397-6399). Feature-list ceiling (Ch1 SS1.2.4, line 1764): 'Up to 15 USB 2.0 ports and 4 Enhanced SuperSpeed ports', 'up to four SuperSpeed bus instances, four high-speed bus instances, and one full-speed/low-speed bus instance'. SPEED CAPABILITY: 5 modes supported -- SSP(10Gbps)/SuperSpeed(5Gbps)/HS(480Mbps)/FS(12Mbps)/LS(1.5Mbps); 'Low-speed mode is not supported in Device mode' (line 1514). DWC_USB31_SSPHY_INTERFACE = None(0)/PIPE3(1)/PIPE4(2) -- select PIPE4 for USB3.1, PIPE3 for USB3.0-only (line 5454). Only 32-bit PIPE data width is supported (8/16-bit unsupported, confirmed both in Unsupported Features list and as a documentation-fix changelog item in Release Notes 2.10a). DWC_USB31_EN_5GBS advertises PSIC=1 5Gbps-only PSI (for USB3.0-mode + USB3.0 PHY pairing). CRITICAL CROSS-REF: DWC_USB31_EN_USB2_ONLY and DWC_USB31_EN_USB30_ONLY flags are referenced 30+ times throughout Chapter 4 formulas (bus width defaults, FIFO depth defaults, etc.) but have NO Parameter Name definition block of their own in this chapter (likely internal/license-tier derived) -- and Databook SS1.5 'Unsupported Features and Usage Restrictions' (line 2035-2053) EXPLICITLY lists both 'USB 3.0-only mode' and 'USB 2.0-only mode' as Unsupported Configurations in this exact IP version. So the formula machinery nominally supports these modes but they are out of the currently-verified/supported envelope -- do not generate/verify a config with either flag set to 1 without flagging it as unsupported. ENDPOINT COUNT: DWC_USB31_NUM_EPS ('Number of Device Mode Endpoints (4-32)', line 5794) = total single-directional device EPs including control EP0 (always present); range ((MODE==3)?3:4)..32, default ((MODE==3)?4:8) -- default-8 models UASP mass-storage+ISOC use case (Control-OUT/IN, Bulk-Data-OUT/IN, Bulk-Command-OUT, Bulk-Status-IN, ISOC-OUT/IN). Cost ~2.5/3.5 Kgates per OUT/IN endpoint. DWC_USB31_NUM_IN_EPS ('Number of Device Mode Active IN Endpoints (2-16)', line 5826) = max simultaneously-active IN EPs incl. control IN0, range 2-16, default (MODE==3)?2:4 -- determines number of Device TxFIFOs/Tx RAM instantiated. Feature-list headline (SS1.2.3, line 1682): 'Up to 16 bidirectional endpoints, including control endpoint 0'. Endpoints are dynamically remappable post-silicon even if USB endpoint numbers are non-contiguous. DWC_USB31_CACHE_TRBS_PER_TRANSFER (4-32, default 16, 16 bytes/TRB) caches TRBs per transfer; scatter-gather guidance given (e.g. 8x128B buffers in 1KB packet needs >=9 TRBs cached). Host-side per-device/interrupt caps: DWC_USB31_NUM_DEVICE_SUPT (64 or 127, memory-only cost, no gate impact; USB-IF Gold Tree reference topology = 19 devices); DWC_USB31_HOST_NUM_INTERRUPTER_SUPT (1-8, default 1, 100 bytes RAM/interrupter, note 'some OS may require minimum of 3 interrupters'); DWC_USB31_HOST_NUM_PERIODIC_EP (32-510, default 32, but Databook recommends 64 for Gold Tree compliance testing since that topology can exceed 32 periodic EPs). Advanced/Premium(EA) Host features gated by license tier: DWC_USB31_VTIOC (xHCI VTIO -- Release Notes confirm 'not supported and should not be enabled in 2.00a', fixed/enhanced by 2.10a), DWC_USB31_EN_DBC (xHCI Debug Capability, requires MDWIDTH!=32), DWC_USB31_LPDDR4_QOS (needs DWC-USB31-LPDDR4-QOS add-on license), DWC_USB31_NUM_PTLHRXE/TXE (1-4 concurrent SSP IN/OUT transfers) gated on internal DWC_USB31_CURRENT_GEN_HST_LSP==2 (inferred, not textually proven, to correlate with the 'Host Premium'/I601-0 license tier vs base Host-Multi-Port A872-0).
